records.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. One standalone destructible boss attachment sprite for Star Guard: a flood-control emitter: crescent teal steel drainage wing module with open orange turbine and ribbed sluice vanes. Match corresponding boss identity and rich prerendered arcade shading of reference atlas. Actual transparent background. Complete individual module, not a complete vessel and not a sheet. Directly overhead orthographic, front towards bottom. Full centred silhouette with at least 18 percent transparent padding, every fin/blade fully in frame. Texture includes detailed shadowed material, clear silhouette, cohesive polished game artwork. No text, frame, ground, detached debris or cast outer shadow. No rectangle filling the transparent space. This is new middle transformation anatomy/equipment, distinctly different from circular generic floating turrets.
